name: Seismic Jaunt
body:
School evocation [cold, water]; Level druid/shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 120 ft.
Area a line up to 120 feet.
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell operates as the spell frigid flurry except it causes an explosion of rock and earth dealing magical bludgeoning damage and knocking the enemies in the area prone. A successful Reflex save halves the damage and negates the prone condition.
